theorems.statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (ι : Euclid n →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (u : Euclid n → Euclid k) (z : Euclid (n + k)) (D : Set (Euclid n)) (v₀ : Euclid n), (∀ v w, inner ℝ (ι v) (ι' w) = 0) → DifferentiableAt ℝ u v₀ → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ∀ y ∈ (fun v => z + ι v + ι' (u v)) '' D, dist y (z + ι v₀ + ι' (u v₀)) < ρ → ∃ t ∈ LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ (fun v => z + ι v + ι' (u v)) v₀ : Euclid n →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)), ‖y - (z + ι v₀ + ι' (u v₀)) - t‖ ≤ ε * ‖y - (z + ι v₀ + ι' (u v₀))‖
